style_summary: Classic Swiss International design translated for modern digital poster formats. Built on strict mathematical grids, extreme negative space, and objective photography or bold geometry. The visual vocabulary relies entirely on high-contrast neo-grotesque sans-serif typography and unembellished imagery. The aesthetic positioning is hyper-rational, universally legible, cold, architectural, and highly intellectual.

environment_variables.FOCAL_IMAGE: objective visual element. Must be devoid of emotional illustration. e.g., 'a high-contrast black and white macro photograph of brutalist concrete architecture' or 'a single perfect red geometric sphere'
environment_variables.HERO_HEADLINE: 2-3 short, impactful words, lowercase or uppercase, e.g., 'Form', 'Grid System', 'Objektiv'
environment_variables.ACCENT_COLOR_THEME: one single high-impact accent color against monochrome. e.g., 'signal red', 'cobalt blue', 'bright yellow'

zones.typography_zone: locked to the top-left or bottom-left grid modules, never center-aligned, distinct separation from imagery
zones.focal_zone: occupies exact mathematical fractions of the canvas (e.g., exactly lower right quadrant)
zones.negative_space: intentional void, massive negative space acting as a structural element, 50-70% empty canvas

composition.depth_logic: strictly 2D flat, absolutely no volumetric drop shadows, depth is achieved solely through scale contrast between massive headlines and micro body copy
composition.scale_contrast: extreme macro vs micro. massive headline text contrasting with tiny, dense blocks of alignment-perfect body copy
composition.edge_treatment: flush and cropped, elements often touch the exact edge of the canvas
permissions: crop images sharply at grid lines
text can run off the edge of the canvas

typography.letterform_character: neutral, stark, geometric, highly legible, neo-grotesque

hierarchy.style: Helvetica bold or similar sans-serif, massive scale
hierarchy.treatment: tight tracking, heavy weight, flush left
hierarchy.position: anchored to a major grid line

hierarchy.treatment: flush left, ragged right, dense block

typography.readability_rule: absolute clarity is mandatory, letters must not be distorted
text_constraints: no justified text (must be ragged right)

color_palette.asphalt_black: #1A1A1A — rich, dense ink black for primary typography
color_palette.industrial_grey: #808080 — neutral concrete grey for secondary elements

color_constraints.dominant: paper_white and asphalt_black must constitute 85% of the visual area
color_constraints.accent_roles: swiss_signal_red appears strictly on ONE focal geometric shape or ONE key word
color_constraints.special_rules: colors must be solid and flat, no gradients unless within the objective photograph

visual_direction.lighting: flat, uniform studio lighting for objects; high-contrast harsh lighting if using architectural photography
visual_direction.mood: rational, objective, authoritative, silent, organized (is NOT playful, emotional, or chaotic)
visual_direction.material_textures: matte offset printing on uncoated thick paper stock

geometric_shapes.physical: perfect circles, squares, or arrows, solid color fill

do: enforce extreme flush-left alignment for all text
avoid: drop shadows (model associates with UI but breaks vintage Swiss print)
